verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Pipecat using AI to review completed calls, score their quality, flag failures or analyze resolution. Pipecat Evals is a pre-deployment test harness that runs scripted conversations against the agent, not automatic review of real calls. Audio recording, transcript capture and latency metrics are only building blocks a developer could use to build such analysis.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's AI reviews my calls for me — scoring quality, flagging failures, and analyzing resolution automatically
